subject: Consolidated term amendment + capacity overlay — redlines and signpath
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: contracts@evermoss.ai, procurement@evermoss.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-20T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Consolidated term amendment + capacity overlay — draft redlines

Team — attaching a working redline of the MSA and a proposed order form that consolidates the multi-term language (to align renewal date to our anniversary) and adds the capacity overlay for the +200k token uplift. Key asks:

- Procurement: can you confirm your PO cadence (single PO vs multiple invoices) and whether Evernoss needs the invoice to match the order form exactly for marketplace reconciliation?
- Legal (Ben/Kim): we flagged Section 4.2 (term alignment) and an Exhibit E carve-out to avoid pro rata exposure for mid-term add-ons — please review and advise if we should propose a coverage ladder instead.
- Customer: Jessica, if you can scan the redlines and share any must-have procurement/legal constraints we can aim to incorporate in this round.

Attachments:
- Evernoss_MSA_redline_20260620.docx (redline)
- Evernoss_OrderForm_v2.xlsx (proposed order form)

I'll follow-up with a short call if there are any blockers. Thanks — Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Sr. Strategic Account Exec, Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0147

From: Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@evermoss.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@evermoss.ai, contracts@evermoss.ai
Date: 2026-06-21T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated term amendment + capacity overlay — draft redlines

Thanks Naomi — received and shared with our procurement and legal teams. A few quick notes from procurement before legal digs in:

- Procurement prefers a single PO covering the initial term + first add-on; can you produce an invoice schedule that maps to the order form (line-level quantities + billing dates)?
- Our standard payment terms are Net 30. Will Redwood accept Net 30 for this renewal?
- We uploaded your order form to our vendor portal; see attached PO template for required fields.

Legal flagged three high-level items for clarity: data residency confirmation for backups, SOC2 evidence, and an indemnity cap question on Section 11.

Attachments:
- PO_template_Evernoss.pdf

We can set a 30-minute sync next week if helpful.

Regards,
Jessica Liu
Senior Manager, Procurement — Evernoss Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-22T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: internal: comments on Evernoss redline (sec 4.2 + exhibits)

Internal note — I reviewed the MSA redline and recommend the following:

1) Keep the term-consolidation language but add a short coverage ladder in Exhibit E so that increases added mid-term are treated as "overlay capacity" with billing prorated to the next invoice period instead of full-term proration. This reduces churn on both sides.
2) For Section 11 (indemnity), propose a compromise cap tied to the order form value for the first 12 months only; avoids open-ended exposure for the uplift.
3) Provide SOC2 artifacts (we have the 2025 report) and a link rather than embedding. Reference: SOC2-Redwood-2025.pdf.

I attached a one-page internal comment doc. If Kimberly agrees, we can push these back in a consolidated redline and call out the PO mapping requirement to Sales Ops.

Attachment:
- redwood_comments_MSA_20260622.docx

-Ben

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@evermoss.ai>
Cc: procurement@evermoss.ai, contracts@evermoss.ai, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-23T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated term amendment + capacity overlay — draft redlines

Jessica — thanks for the quick turnaround. We've incorporated sales/legal preferences into a consolidated redline (see attached), and called out the invoice schedule mapping you asked for. Highlights:

- Exhibit E now includes a "capacity overlay" ladder: small mid-term bumps (<25% of baseline) will be billed on the next invoice cycle pro rata; large uplifts will follow the order form schedule.
- Proposed indemnity cap scoped to order value for 12 months — Ben put together the rationale in the comment doc.
- We will provide SOC2 evidence via shared drive link rather than attaching to the DocuSign packet.

Proposed next steps:
1) Procurement to confirm Net 30 acceptance and whether PO number must appear on the DocuSign envelope.
2) If OK, we'll generate a DocuSign package for the MSA + order form and share the signpath (target sign window 7 business days).

Call link to propose times: https://calendly.com/naomi-f/evernoss-redwood-30m

Attachments:
- Evernoss_MSA_redline_20260623.docx (consolidated)
- Evernoss_OrderForm_v2.xlsx

Thanks — Naomi

From: Jessica Liu <jessica.liu@evermoss.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@evermoss.ai, contracts@evermoss.ai
Date: 2026-06-24T15:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Consolidated term amendment + capacity overlay — redlines and signpath

Appreciate the consolidated redline. A couple of clarifications from legal/procurement:

- Net 30 is OK provided the invoice references the PO number and is sent to ap@evermoss.ai. Please ensure the DocuSign packet contains a visible PO field.
- Legal is OK with the 12-month indemnity cap tied to order value, pending our counsel's final read — expect a redline comment on the indemnity paragraph tomorrow.
- Data residency: we don't require EU residency for this account, but we do need confirmation that routine backups are stored in US regions only.
- SOC2: thanks for the drive link — can you share before you send the envelope so our security team can pre-clear?

Please include the DocuSign link and we will route internally once the PO number is inserted.

Jessica

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>

- Sales Ops: please produce the invoice schedule that maps line items to billing dates and include a PO field for Evernoss (ap@evermoss.ai). Mark deal EV-2026-0342.
- Security: Naomi, share the SOC2 drive link now (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSOC2_ARTIFACTS) so Evernoss can pre-clear.
- Signpath: generate DocuSign envelope with fields: PO#, signer name, order_form_line_items table. Target signature window: 7 business days.

Once DocuSign is live, Naomi to send the envelope link to Jessica and procurement. Ben/Kim — please watch for the indemnity comment tomorrow and I'll escalate if counsel pulls back.

-Marissa
